resources.string: Safe mode is on: all third-party plugins are disabled
Plugin settings and data are kept and restored when you leave safe mode. Running tasks may have been interrupted.

All third-party plugins will be disabled (built-in plugins are unaffected). Plugin settings are not lost and come back when you leave safe mode. Running tasks may be interrupted. Restart the Web service afterwards to apply.
New plugins cannot be installed or enabled in safe mode; leave safe mode first.
